position_bias.maximum_cell_count: Binomial(n,0.2) upper quantile with Bonferroni alpha/5

decision_rule.INTERPRETABILITY_COMPARABLE_COVERAGE_IMP: macro CI includes zero, both site CIs include zero, and z-score eligibility exceeds 2x control at both sites
decision_rule.INTERPRETABILITY_TRADEOFF: macro z-score-minus-control 95% CI upper bound is below zero
decision_rule.JUDGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: calibration or final scientific position diagnostic fails
decision_rule.SEMANTIC_INTERPRETABILITY_IMPROVED: macro z-score-minus-control 95% CI lower bound is above zero and neither site point estimate is negative

evaluation.primary_estimand: uniform over eligible natural-firing features with eligible-stratum weighting

protocol.label_balance: each canonical context occupies every opaque label within a parent
protocol.position_balance: each canonical context occupies every displayed position within a parent
